name: To Love-Ru Diary~ - Peach
original_name: とらぶるだいあり～・ぴーち
source:
Momo, the third princess of Deviluke, urges Rito to train his sexual skills.
She seems to be bold and in a strong attitude but in fact she is also a virgin.
While his training progresses, their relationship gradually changes...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ138400.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
